name: attitude_propagator
interface: propagate_euler / propagate_principal_axis: torque-free attitude q(t) under textbook convention conv-(a), dq/dt = -0.5 ω ⊗ q.  [in_use=True]

functions.name: propagate_attitude
functions.signature: propagate_attitude(q0, omega0, times, mode, inertia_tensor=None, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12)
functions.role: Canonical entry point: routes (q0, ω, t) to the closed-form principal-axis path or the ODE Euler path by the mode flag.

functions.name: propagate_principal_axis
functions.role: Closed-form constant-ω attitude via the quaternion exponential q(t)=exp(-0.5 ω·t)⊗q0 (LEFT-multiply, conv-(a)).

functions.name: propagate_euler
functions.signature: propagate_euler(q0, omega0, inertia_tensor, times, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12)
functions.role: DOP853 integration of the coupled torque-free Euler equations + quaternion kinematics for a tumbling body. The ω-sign that the 2.0.0 fix corrected lives here (L318).

versions.change_reason: Initial implementation — conv-(b), dq/dt = +0.5 ω ⊗ q (LEFT). Opposite sign of textbook conv-(a); silently produced conv-(b) q the renderer mis-read.

ω-sign convention FIX: +0.5 → -0.5 in propagate_euler L318 + propagate_principal_axis L177-184 (and lib/jacobi_propagator.py:432). Restores exact L_J2000 conservation. BLAST RADIUS: invalidated all pre-fix numerical findings s001–s066; cohort regenerated.
